tagline.text: Every space starts with documents everyone can rely on. That is what I create.

services.title: Planning capacity when projects run in parallel.
services.lead: As an external planner I take on clearly defined parts of your project – backed by more than 20 years in exhibition construction. Qualified specialist partners handle production, installation, structural engineering and electrics.

trust.title: One point of contact
trust.text: for planning, documents and coordination – direct, without intermediaries.

trust.title: 20+ years of experience
trust.text: Technical draughtsman (wood technology) and certified exhibition and event project manager (IHK).

trust.title: Clear scope
trust.text: Services, revision rounds and deadlines are agreed in writing up front.

package.title: Per project or as a monthly quota.
package.text: After your brief I estimate the effort and propose scope, deliverables and dates – for a single project or as a quota with fixed hours and response times. I only take on as many projects as I can handle with care.

network.title: Execution by specialist partners
network.text: I plan and coordinate. You normally commission production and installation directly from your partners – CL Projektwerk is neither a workshop nor a general contractor.

process.title: Six steps from brief to handover.

briefing.title: Brief and scope
briefing.text: Clarify task, deadline and existing documents. We define what I deliver, how many revision rounds are planned and who approves.

concept.title: Concept and coordination
concept.text: Spatial idea, visualisations, floor plan and elevations: you decide on a clear basis before detailed planning starts.

planning.title: Technical planning
planning.text: Dimensioned detail and production drawings, part lists and interfaces. Specialist partners provide structural engineering, permits and electrical planning.

production.title: Work preparation
production.text: Material and quantity overviews, documents per production partner, procurement and scheduling. Production takes place at the specialist company.
production.alt: Animation of CNC machining as an example of production data (visualisation); the specialist partner carries out the manufacturing

logistics.title: Coordination of trades
logistics.text: Schedule overview, quotation comparisons and coordination so that transport, build-up and technology fit together.
logistics.alt: Time-lapse concept animation of the build-up (visualisation)

onsite.title: Approvals and handover
onsite.text: Approvals and changes are documented and all documents are handed over in full. On-site meetings by arrangement.

process.lead: Clear steps, one fixed point of contact and documented approvals keep every project traceable.
process.note: The films illustrate individual workflow steps (visualisations). They do not show the assembly of a specific exhibition stand.

about.name: Christof Laufersweiler
about.role: Planning and project control for exhibition stands, brand spaces and interior fit-out
about.text: I have worked in exhibitions and events for more than 20 years – as a technical draughtsman (wood technology), project manager in stand construction, employed managing director of a stand-building company and most recently as Senior Project Manager at C3 EXPO GmbH (11/2025 – 10/2026). With CL Projektwerk I offer external planning and project capacity from Leipzig for stand builders, agencies, interior fit-out companies and exhibitors.

seo.title: Questions about working together.
seo.intro: CL Projektwerk is an external planning and project office in Leipzig for technical exhibition planning, work preparation and project control. Specialist partners carry out the work; I deliver planning and coordination.

faq.a: It depends on scope, deliverables and deadlines. After a short brief you receive a quotation – for a project or a monthly quota.

faq.q: When should I get in touch?
faq.a: As soon as task and deadline are fixed. My capacity is limited; I check short-notice requests against my current workload.
Yes. Technical planning, work preparation, project control, concept or reuse planning can each be booked individually.

faq.q: Do you also manufacture and install?
faq.a: No. Specialist partners handle production, transport, installation, structural engineering, permits and electrics – usually commissioned directly by you. I plan and coordinate.
Planning is mostly done from Leipzig. On-site meetings and travel are agreed in advance.
